GWA_command_triangle.text: On command-deck problem pages, keep Samira's command position, Owen's navigation station and Mina's sensor station spatially repeatable so eyelines and information flow remain legible.

GWA_two_person_test.text: For calibration/tests, stage one person changing hardware or reference conditions while another reads the independent result. Avoid multiple characters staring at the same unexplained screen.
